SUMMARY: The gateway design is directionally right (server-resolved Scope, storage-side predicates, per-hit revalidation, Go-only), but two AC-critical proofs are hollow: the concurrency suite asserts nothing and the RLS role-posture test is a no-op skip, so AC-2/AC-3 are not demonstrably met.
Additional gaps versus the approved contract: config env validation and structured audit are unimplemented, the PG store path is untested, and validation failures leak as 500s.
Recommend: add real assertions + CI-fail-on-missing-DSN to role posture, make the concurrent suite verify isolation, wire declared config and audit, and test edpdata/pg scoped paths before Gate 2.
